content.text: Digital creators in regions with restricted access to conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-broken-here-infrastructure-3|payment]] platforms face a significant challenge: how to host and sell digital products like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-works-how-deploy-18|How How]], courses, and templates without the high fees and limitations imposed by services like PayPal or Gumroad. GitHub Pages emerges as a powerful solution for free digital product store hosting, allowing you to maintain full ownership of your sales and customer relationships without unnecessary charges. This post breaks down the steps to leverage GitHub Pages effectively.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-8. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free hosting service that allows you to publish web content directly from a GitHub repository. For digital creators, this means you can create and manage your online store without relying on third-party platforms that charge exorbitant fees. With platforms like Gumroad taking up to 10% per sale, using GitHub Pages can drastically reduce your overhead, keeping more revenue in your pocket. Moreover, it provides a straightforward way to deliver digital products automatically, ensuring that buyers receive their purchases instantly upon payment confirmation.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-11|COREMERCH guide to architecture]] behind using GitHub Pages for your digital product store involves several key components. First, you set up a GitHub repository where your product files will be stored. GitHub Pages then serves these files as a website, enabling customers to view and purchase your products. To handle payments, you can integrate NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges only a 0.5% fee, significantly lower than traditional platforms. This architecture allows for seamless payment processing and automated product delivery, all while retaining total control over your sales.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is specifically designed for digital creators operating in countries where payment processing services like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or severely restricted. If you're selling ebooks, templates, or any digital goods and want to avoid high fees, GitHub Pages combined with NOWPayments offers a robust solution. This setup empowers you to build a sustainable online business while ensuring that you keep the entirety of your earnings. It’s built for creators who value independence and want to establish a direct connection with their customers.
GitHub Pages offers free hosting, eliminating platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effective deployment of a digital product store using GitHub Pages requires several crucial components. At its core, you'll need a GitHub repository to host your site. For automated payment processing, NOWPayments acts as the payment gateway, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can handle backend functions like order confirmation and product delivery. Combined, these components create a streamlined system that allows you to sell digital products effortlessly. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all necessary blueprints and templates to facilitate this setup, providing a comprehensive resource for creators.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with your GitHub Pages digital product store, first, set up a GitHub account and create a new repository for your site. Next, upload your product files and configure GitHub Pages to serve your repository. After that, integrate NOWPayments for payment processing by following the provided documentation. Finally, set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate product delivery. Each of these steps will put you on the path to launching your digital storefront without the constraints of traditional payment platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency payments. This approach allows you to keep a larger share of your sales revenue and maintain full control over your product delivery and customer data, ensuring a seamless transaction experience.
NOWPayments keeps transaction costs low, ensuring higher profits.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider integrating GitHub Pages with NOWPayments. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides a comprehensive setup to help you build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online using GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. By doing so, you avoid the high fees associated with traditional platforms while maintaining control over your sales.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

Using GitHub Pages combined with NOWPayments gives you the best solution for selling digital downloads without platform fees. This setup minimizes costs while allowing you to manage your store independently.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without using platforms like Gumroad or Payhip by utilizing GitHub Pages for hosting and integrating NOWPayments for secure cryptocurrency transactions.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges only a 0.5% fee on transactions, which is significantly lower compared to platforms like Gumroad that can charge 10%. This low fee structure helps you retain more revenue from your sales.
How do I automate product delivery after payment?

You can automate product delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These tools allow you to set up backend logic to ensure that customers receive their purchased products immediately after payment confirmation.
